lead_with.title: Fund admin is scaling: where do the next teams go?
lead_with.text: Juniper Square says its **fund administration business grew at a 3-year CAGR above 100%** and now has **US$300B+ under administration**. Each new fund needs accountants, investor-services and onboarding staff. Ask where the next 100-150 operations roles will sit.

lead_with.title: New York hours at about half the cost
lead_with.text: A Finance Montréal-commissioned 2026 cost study puts a 150-person financial operation at about **US$18.9M a year in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**. Montreal is in the **New York time zone**, bilingual, and complements the company's **Mumbai and Bangalore** teams with same-day coverage for US GPs.

lead_with.title: Credits that fit both halves of the business
lead_with.text: Quebec's **IFC tax credit** (24% of eligible salaries, up to **C$18,000 per employee per year**, min. 6 eligible staff) covers activities such as **third-party fund administration support**: eligibility for Juniper Square's roles **to be confirmed** case by case. For software and AI engineers, Quebec's **e-business/AI credit (CDAEIA)** offers about **30% of eligible salaries**; exact rate and eligibility **to be confirmed** with Investissement Québec.

person.name: Stephanie D. Miller
person.text: Appointed **Chief Operating Officer of Juniper Square in July 2025**, reporting into a founder-led company (CEO and co-founder Alex Robinson). More than **20 years** in financial services, technology and operations. Career: nearly a decade at **Citco Fund Services** (built its middle-office services business), **SS&C** (SVP, sales implementation and strategy, 2016), **Global Head of Fund Services at J.P. Morgan** (four years), **CEO and Management Board member of Intertrust Group** (from Jan 2018), **President and CEO of Hazeltree** (Oct 2023 to Dec 2024), plus Credit Suisse; also an **independent board director**. Education: **BA in accounting, Queens College (CUNY), class of 1991**. **To be confirmed:** that she is still COO in Oct 2026 (she replied from a personal email) and whether she is based in Tampa or New York.

company.text: Juniper Square is a founder-led US company (founded 2014, San Francisco) that positions itself as the **operations partner for private markets**: investor portal and CRM, fund accounting and **fund administration** services, and the **JunieAI** platform. It serves **2,300+ GPs** (real estate, private equity, venture, private credit). Physical offices are in **San Francisco, New York, Mumbai and Bangalore**; staff also work remotely across **27 US states, 2 Canadian provinces, India, Luxembourg and England**. It has been **hiring fund administration staff remotely in Canada** (job posts listed on Built In Calgary and Vancouver). Recent moves: Forstone Luxembourg acquisition (May 2025), Tenor Digital (private credit, Oct 2025), **Sightglass** (AI for IR, Apr 2026), Nasdaq eVestment partnership (2026), a 'headless' API opening to any AI (Jun 2026), a fund-admin oversight AI agent (Jul 2026), and its **first CIO** (Oct 2026). Named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2026.

financials.text: **Series D (Jun 2025): US$130M at a US$1.1B valuation**, led by **Ribbit Capital** with Fifth Wall, Redpoint, HighSage and Blue Owl. **Feb 2023: US$133M** growth round led by Owl Rock (Blue Owl), valuation not disclosed. **Sep 2025:** strategic investment from **Nasdaq Ventures** (amount not disclosed). Total raised: **more than US$350M** (company job posts). **Revenue / ARR: not publicly disclosed.** Reported growth signals: fund administration **3-year CAGR above 100%** (2025), fund-admin AUA grew **more than 4x** in 2022; **1,000+ employees**.

industry.title: Private markets keep outsourcing fund admin
industry.text: GPs increasingly hand fund accounting and investor services to tech-enabled administrators. Juniper Square competes with incumbents Stephanie knows from the inside (Citco, SS&C, J.P. Morgan, Intertrust).

industry.title: Fund-services hubs follow cost and time zone
industry.text: Administrators run multi-site models (US, India, Europe). Montreal already hosts large fund-services and banking operations, including **State Street, BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole and Morgan Stanley**.

industry.title: AI changes the ops mix
industry.text: Juniper Square is pushing AI agents into fund admin. That shifts hiring toward **data, AI and control roles**: Montreal has about **150,000 tech specialists** and a strong AI research base.

industry.title: Retail and private credit growth
industry.text: Juniper Square reports the rise of retail investors and private credit (Tenor Digital deal), both of which add investor accounts and servicing volume.
